classical_source_layers.basis: User Portuguese Parashara CP1252 lines2305-2321 and digitized Sanskrit BPHS 26.5–9
classical_source_layers.interpretation: Directed exact graha ecliptic longitude difference and ordinary aspect magnitude in virupas (0..60). Separate from special Saturn/Mars/Jupiter aspects and Drigbala aggregation of benefic/malefic aspects.
classical_source_layers.method: piecewise defined in accompanying source code

classical_source_layers.basis: Original Sanskrit Saravali Ch4 verses32-33 (see B37), separately translated and corrected
classical_source_layers.interpretation: Whole-sign-house aspects with fractional strengths 1/4 houses3,10; 1/2 houses5,9; 3/4 houses4,8; full seventh

classical_source_layers.basis: Uploaded Sanjay Rath Lesson13 PDF257–258, original short Jaimini Sutra1.1.2 plus separate Rath commentary
classical_source_layers.interpretation: Movable signs aspect fixed except adjacent; fixed aspect movable except adjacent; dual signs mutually aspect other dual (distinct) signs; same/adjacent sign pairs do not aspect.
classical_source_layers.source_layer: Commentarial operationalization; do not attribute all four criteria literally to the single Sanskrit sutra

astronomical_input.qualification: Approximately 28° angular maximum is rounded; 29° test is a conservative declared bound below the 30° source threshold. The raw angular-to-ecliptic longitude condition should be independently verified when proof-grade astronomical precision required.

sun_mercury_result.why: With separation restricted below 30°, BPHS ordinary degree aspect is zero and Sun/Mercury signs must be same or neighboring, which neither other source method aspects.
sun_mercury_result.importance: This is a conditional mathematical source result, not a universal statement about every astrology tradition or about the validity of predictions.

modern_software_reference_quality.class: Independent modern astrology-software documentation, NOT Kalyanavarman's Saravali original Sanskrit text

errors.problem: For d=165 it gives -30 virupas, contradicting the stated [0,60] range and original source progression; source-supported mathematical formula is 2*(d-150).
For d>300 returns negative, whereas general aspect source is zero in 300–360. The table's 270–330 row overextends an otherwise valid range.

modern_software_reference_quality.disposition: Document as derivative implementation error; do not modify classical sources or adopt negative aspect values.

source_version_behavior.ordinary_bp_full: Sphuta Drishti continuous; Mars/Jupiter/Saturn special drishti not implemented
source_version_behavior.sanskrit_saravali: Discrete restored sign fractions; English uploaded variant kept separately in B37
source_version_behavior.rath_jaimini: Commentarial sign-to-sign theory rather than graha aspect
source_version_behavior.explicit_no_default_model: Three methods selected by separate functions, never merged

verification.test_360_degree_sweep_step: 0.01° checked source-fidelity 0≤value≤60 and continuity at boundaries
